cited.quote: additional 2.17 lakh households have been approved to be covered with toilet facilities under Phase II of SBM (G)

rationale: C1 (policy note) says further households were approved for toilets under SBM (G) Phase II, but gives no order, GO or date for constructing rural toilets by this government. C4 is a Model Village Award GO, not a toilet construction order. No dated official order found.

cited.quote: earmarked for sanitation and maintenance of ODF status

rationale: C2 and C3 sanction Finance Commission basic untied grants to rural local bodies; they are untied and not sanctions for building toilets or sanitation facilities. C1 describes coverage but no fund sanction. Only related activity, so not started.

No extract concerns MLAs uploading the status of public complaints or demands. C1 is the MLA constituency development fund scheme, C2 and C3 are police and human rights online complaints, C4 is general governance. None is about this commitment.

cited.quote: provides the free supply of electricity upto 750 units bi-monthly to Powerloom weavers

rationale: C1 (Dec 2021) shows free electricity still at 750 units bi-monthly for powerlooms with the scheme continuing in 2021-22; no step toward 1000 units appears. C2 only lists budget lines.

cited.quote: components of the programme and funding pattern under the Swachh Bharat Mission - Urban 2.0 (SBM 2.0)

rationale: C4 is a GO of 2022-01-11 granting administrative sanction for SBM-Urban 2.0 in Tamil Nadu, with solid waste management funding for ULBs including those under 1 lakh population. It plausibly covers small and medium cities, but the extract is not specific to a 50,000 threshold.

cited.quote: permit the sale of Palm Jaggery through select Fair Price Shops run by Cooperatives

rationale: C1 is G.O. (Ms) No.75 dated 30.09.2021 permitting sale of palm jaggery through select cooperative and Amutham fair price shops alongside other PDS commodities, on pilot basis and optional for cardholders. C3 gives supply arrangements. Scope is select shops, but it is the first operationalisation.

No extract concerns expansion or modernisation of the Salem integrated steel plant. C1 mentions Salem Steel Plant only for a Covid care centre power supply; others cover sugar mills, dairy, sheds and MSME subsidy.

cited.quote: tracking of buses is being introduced

rationale: C1 says tracking of buses is being introduced and C2 describes a Safe City CCTV and SOS panic button project for MTC buses. Neither is a mandate of GPS tracking and helplines for public and private buses; C4 is a KfW procurement GO. No mandating order shown.

cited.quote: A sum of Rs.37.00 lakh has been sanctioned to set up these centres through the NGO’s on pilot

rationale: Directional commitment. C2 (policy note dated 2021-12-29) reports Elders Resource Centres day-care centres set up through NGOs with a sanction, functioning in two blocks in 37 districts. This is a dedicated measure with NGOs, but the exact start date is not stated, so only the year is given.

cited.quote: have accorded administrative sanction to continue the Free Supply of Uniform Scheme for the Academic Year 2021-22

rationale: C1 shows the uniform scheme continuing for 2021-22, with cloth produced by handloom, pedalloom and powerloom looms alike. No order makes contracts exclusive to powerloom weavers. Same activity carrying on, no step for exclusivity.

cited.quote: had been proposed in the present action plan for the shoreline protection along the coast of Tamil Nadu

rationale: C2 describes proposed shoreline protection structures with a proposed budget in an action plan; this is a plan, not a GO, tender or sanction. C1 covers shelterbelt plantations and C4 a marine elite force, which are different subjects.

None of the extracts is an order simplifying approvals for houses and offices on own land. C1 and C3 concern a Government building committee for departmental offices, C2 land exchange procedures, C4 and C5 house sites and regularisation.

cited.quote: accord “Go live” Permission for implementation of first phase of Single Window Approval in Chennai
Automated Building Plan Approval System / Single Window Approval

rationale: C2 (GO dated 2022-04-18) grants go-live permission for the online Single Window Approval for planning permission in CMDA and DTCP from 01.05.2022; C1 describes the automated building plan approval system. Phase one only, with local bodies to follow, but it launches the online portal.

cited.quote: Water Connection under sections 131 and 132 of the Tamil Nadu District Municipalities Act, 1920.

rationale: C3 amends business facilitation rules with time limits for services, including water connection, but the listed timelines are garbled and show 30 days, not 15 days for drinking water connections. C1 and C2 state aims only. No clear 15-day order.

No extract concerns sugar factories producing or exporting electricity. C1, C2 and C3 cover sugar industry productivity, farmer incentives and seed schemes; C4 is labour rules. None is about this commitment.

No extract shows a support scheme or incentive for sugar factories generating electricity. C1, C3 and C4 are farmer incentives and seed schemes; C2 and C5 describe the sugar industry generally. None is about power generation.

cited.quote: Creation of Women Entrepreneurship by providing 5 goats/sheep at 100 percent subsidy

rationale: No extract shows an interest-free Rs 50,000 loan for BPL women. C4 is a goat/sheep subsidy for poor widows and destitute women, a different benefit. C1 and C3 are a SIPCOT soft loan to companies, C2 SHG credit, C5 minority loans.

No extract concerns a joint committee of secretaries and a State Administrative Tribunal. C1 and C4 are Industrial Tribunal selection rules, C2 GST tribunals, C3 maintenance tribunals, C5 RTI officer assignments.

cited.quote: effective reporting/ monitoring of developments in identifying and eviction of encroachments in water bodies and other Government lands
should initiate eviction process after identifying encroachments in objectionable Government lands with priority given to Water bodies

rationale: C1 and C4 (GO of 2022-02-08) form committees and direct field officers to start eviction with priority to water bodies. This is an official step, but no extract shows encroachments actually removed along water bodies. C5 concerns temple lands.

cited.quote: Tamil Nadu Minorities Economic Development Corporation sanctions educational loan to the Minorities who pursue Professional Courses

rationale: No extract shows the government repaying graduate education loans. C2 describes an existing minority education loan scheme for lending, C4 a fee concession for government school students, C1 financial assistance. Only related activity.
